name: City of Toronto Vacant Home Tax
description: Annual tax of 3% of current value assessment on Toronto residential property vacant six months or more in the taxation year (from the 2024 taxation year); owners must declare by 30 April.

attributes.vacancy_test: vacant six months or more in the year

limitations: Ottawa and Hamilton vacant-unit taxes were not researched in Phase 1.
